title: resource.state_changed@1
description: Lifecycle state of a managed resource or an app's own service (a Cerberus resource, or the Torque, Hadron, Nanite or Fragments Engine daemon). One vocabulary for every app. Emitted only when the state changed: from differs from to, except a forced re-assertion (forced=true). restarted and recovered are not states: they are transitions, carried in reason (restart, recovered, operator_stop, crash, health_failed) and trigger. wedged (process up, health failing past a threshold window) also raises alert.raised with rule_id <app>.wedged and coalesce_key the resource id, and alert.cleared when it ends. Hosts use fleet.node.*, not this kind. Unknown fields are allowed.

kind.description: human, agent, scheduler, hook, reaction or system

reason.description: A short closed code, never free text or an error message: restart, recovered, operator_stop, crash, health_failed, deploy, boot, shutdown.

labels.description: Where and how the resource runs. Strings only; never configuration values or environment variables.
